license_required.quote: "Emergency medical technician" means a person licensed pursuant to chapter 4.1 of this title to provide emergency medical services.

available.quote: each business/profession-related board shall issue a license, certification, or permit to perform professional services regulated by each such board to a person: Who is certified or licensed in another state for at least one year to perform professional services in a state other than Rhode Island
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 5-88 Military Member and Spouse License Issuance

requirements.value: Military members and their spouses licensed in another state for at least one year may receive a license if requirements are substantially equivalent; otherwise a temporary license is issued while completing state-specific requirements.
requirements.quote: Issuing the person a digitally verifiable license, certificate, or permit that can also be recognized by other states, if, in the opinion of the board, the requirements for certification or licensure of such other state are substantially equivalent to that required in this state
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 5-88 Military Member and Spouse License Issuance
